## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Large Cap Fund Direct Growth

Groww Large Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Saptarshee Chatterjee is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Large Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹53.13.
The Groww Large Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 7 days.
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme seeks to achieve long-term appreciation from a portfolio that invests predominantly in equity and equity related securities of blue chip large cap companies.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Short Term Fund Direct Growth

Groww Short Term Fund Direct Growth is a Debt Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Kaustubh Sule is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Short Term Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹2,555.99.
The Groww Short Term Fund Direct Growth is rated Moderate risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500.
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme will endeavor to generate stable returns over short term with a low risk strategy while maintaining liquidity through a portfolio comprising of debt and money market instruments.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Nippon India Small Cap Fund Direct Growth

Nippon India Small Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Nippon India Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 30 Jun 1995. Samir Rachh is the Current Fund Manager of Nippon India Small Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹7,57,200 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹208.29.
The Nippon India Small Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme seeks to generate long term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in equity and equity related instruments of small cap companies.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Quant Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth

Quant Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Quant Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 15 Apr 1996. Varun Pattani is the Current Fund Manager of Quant Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹1,01,407 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹255.99.
The Quant Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹1,000. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000. Exit load of 0.50% if redeemed within 3 months.
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme aims at providing long term capital appreciation and generating income with a diversified portfolio of Mid Cap companies.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth

HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by HDFC Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Dec 1999. Dhruv Muchhal is the Current Fund Manager of HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹9,44,244 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹163.67.
The HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹100. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation /income by investing predominantly in Small-Cap companies.

Fund benchmarkBSE 250 SmallCap Total Return Index

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Kotak Small Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 05 Aug 1994. ## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Quant Small Cap Fund Direct Plan Growth

Quant Small Cap Fund Direct Plan Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Quant Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 15 Apr 1996. Varun Pattani is the Current Fund Manager of Quant Small Cap Fund Direct Plan Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹1,01,407 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹315.58.
The Quant Small Cap Fund Direct Plan Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹1,000. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme seeks to generate capital appreciation by investing in a well-diversified portfolio of small cap companies.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Quant Infrastructure Fund Direct Growth

Quant Infrastructure Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Quant Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 15 Apr 1996. Varun Pattani is the Current Fund Manager of Quant Infrastructure Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹1,01,407 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹46.24.
The Quant Infrastructure Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹1,000. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000. Exit load of 0.50% if redeemed within 3 months.
;

#### Investment Objective

The fund aims to invest predominantly in equity and equity related instruments of the companies in the infrastructure sector.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth

HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by HDFC Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Dec 1999. Chirag Setalvad is the Current Fund Manager of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹9,44,244 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹236.72.
The HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹100. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About SBI Contra Direct Plan Growth

SBI Contra Direct Plan Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by SBI Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 29 Jun 1987. Dinesh Balachandran is the Current Fund Manager of SBI Contra Direct Plan Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹12,71,425 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹421.66.
The SBI Contra Direct Plan Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000. Exit load of 0.25% if redeemed within 30 days and 0.10% if redeemed after 30 days but on or before 90 days.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

;

The Scheme seeks to generate long term capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity related instruments of small cap companies.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Groww Multicap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. The scheme seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in equity and equity-related instruments of large, mid and small-cap companies.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Value Fund Direct Growth

Groww Value Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Saptarshee Chatterjee is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Value Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹33.75.
The Groww Value Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
;

#### Investment Objective

The Scheme seeks to generate returns through a combination of dividend income and capital appreciation by investing primarily in well-diversified portflio of value stocks.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Groww Banking & Financial Services Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. ## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

Groww Liquid Fund Direct Growth is a Debt Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 09 Aug 2026 is ₹2,737.95.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Overnight Fund Direct Growth

Groww Overnight Fund Direct Growth is a Debt Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Kaustubh Sule is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Overnight Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 09 Aug 2026 is ₹1,412.92.
The Groww Overnight Fund Direct Growth is rated Low risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500.
;

#### Investment Objective

The Scheme seeks to provide reasonable returns commensurate with low risk and providing a high level of liquidity, through investments made primarily in overnight securities having maturity of 1 business day.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Nifty Total Market Index Fund Direct Growth

Groww Nifty Total Market Index Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Shashi Kumar is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Nifty Total Market Index Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹14.29.
The Groww Nifty Total Market Index Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 0.25%, if redeemed within 7 days.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Nifty India Railways PSU Index Fund Direct Growth

Groww Nifty India Railways PSU Index Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Shashi Kumar is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Nifty India Railways PSU Index Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹8.00.
The Groww Nifty India Railways PSU Index Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 30 days.
;

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Nifty India Defence ETF FoF Direct Growth

Groww Nifty India Defence ETF FoF Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Aakash Ashokkumar Chauhan is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Nifty India Defence ETF FoF Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹14.32.
The Groww Nifty India Defence ETF FoF Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 30 days.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Nifty EV & New Age Automotive ETF FoF Direct Growth

Groww Nifty EV & New Age Automotive ETF FoF Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Aakash Ashokkumar Chauhan is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Nifty EV & New Age Automotive ETF FoF Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹10.42.
The Groww Nifty EV & New Age Automotive ETF FoF Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 30 days.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Nifty Non Cyclical Consumer Index Fund Direct Growth

Groww Nifty Non Cyclical Consumer Index Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Aakash Ashokkumar Chauhan is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Nifty Non Cyclical Consumer Index Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹10.70.
The Groww Nifty Non Cyclical Consumer Index Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 30 days.
;

#### Investment Objective

metadata.title: Groww Nifty Non Cyclical Consumer Index Fund Direct Growth - NAV, Mutual Fund Performance & Portfolio

#### Investment Objective

The Scheme seeks to generate long term capital growth by investing in securities of the Nifty Non-Cyclical Consumer Index (TRI) in the same proportion / weightage with an aim to provide returns before expenses that track the total return of Nifty Non-Cyclical Consumer Index, subject to tracking errors.;

Fund benchmarkNifty Non-Cyclical Consumer Total Return Index

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Nifty Private Bank Index Fund Direct Growth

Groww Nifty Private Bank Index Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Aakash Ashokkumar Chauhan is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Nifty Private Bank Index Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹10.21.
The Groww Nifty Private Bank Index Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Gold ETF FOF Direct Growth

Groww Gold ETF FOF Direct Growth is a Commodities Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Wilfred Peter Gonsalves is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Gold ETF FOF Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹18.30.
The Groww Gold ETF FOF Direct Growth is rated High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 30 days.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth

Groww Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is a Commodities Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Wilfred Peter Gonsalves is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹22.03.
The Groww Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 30 days.
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme seeks to provide returns that are in line with returns provided by Groww Silver Exchange Traded Fund.

Fund benchmarkDomestic Prices of Silver

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.

### About Groww Nifty 200 ETF FoF Direct Growth

Groww Nifty 200 ETF FoF Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Groww Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Apr 2008. Shashi Kumar is the Current Fund Manager of Groww Nifty 200 ETF FoF Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,548 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 07 Aug 2026 is ₹11.87.
The Groww Nifty 200 ETF FoF Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 30 days.
;

#### Investment Objective

The scheme is to generate long-term capital growth by investing in units of the Groww Nifty 200 ETF.

## Understand terms

##### Expense ratio

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.

##### Tax

A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.

##### Exit load

A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.

##### Stamp duty

A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.
